source: Authored for S04 (Issue #91) from the token-handling rules in docs/architecture/connection.md#approval-and-token and the saved-token URL shape in docs/architecture/protocol.md#endpoints. Not captured from a physical television.
redaction: Contains no address, MAC, Wi-Fi name, certificate, serial, account or personal identifier. The approval token is the placeholder [fixture-token]; the test injects the saved token value it pre-staged so it can prove the token was or was not placed on the wire. No host, port or URL appears in any frame.
notes: Second connection on the adopted TLS remote channel with a saved pairing. The saved security identity matches, so the saved token is presented on the connect URL and the television accepts the session directly: no unauthorized event, no approval prompt, and the session reaches Ready. Proves the S04 token-resume contract: force-stopping and reopening the same television does not prompt again.
